marketMood: Risk-off tilt as Nvidia's AI earnings test and Fed Chair Warsh's Jackson Hole debut drive caution, with Treasury yields at multi-year highs and Chinese tech under selling pressure.

upcomingEvents.event: Nvidia Q2 FY2027 Earnings (after market close)
Fed Chair Warsh Jackson Hole Keynote Speech

topStories.headline: Nvidia Q2 Earnings Tonight Are the AI Trade's Biggest Test Yet
topStories.summary: Wall Street expects Q2 FY2027 revenue of $92.2B (+97% YoY) and EPS of ~$2.09, nearly double year-ago levels, setting a high bar for positive surprise.
topStories.marketImpact: Nasdaq 100 futures ↓0.5% pre-market as investors de-risk; NVDA ↑/↓ sharply on the print; AMD, AVGO, ASML, SMH highly reactive

topStories.headline: Fed Chair Warsh Makes Jackson Hole Debut Friday — Rate Hike Odds in Focus
topStories.summary: Newly confirmed Fed Chair Kevin Warsh delivers his first keynote at the Jackson Hole symposium on August 28, with markets pricing ~33% odds of a September rate hike as inflation holds at 3.4%.
topStories.marketImpact: USD ↑ risk into Friday; bonds volatile; gold near 3-month highs; rate-sensitive equities cautious

topStories.headline: US Plans 7.5% China Overcapacity Tariff Before Sept. 24 Xi-Trump Summit
topStories.summary: The Trump administration is set to impose a 7.5% levy on Chinese goods for excess manufacturing capacity, precisely filling the 20% tariff cap agreed with Beijing on July 27; Xi-Trump summit confirmed for September 24.
topStories.marketImpact: Chinese exporters ↓; EV, solar, steel sectors most exposed; 9988.HK, 0700.HK, FXI, KWEB under pressure; summit context limits worst-case downside

topStories.headline: Alibaba Closes Record $10B Hong Kong Share Sale to Fund AI Infrastructure
topStories.summary: Alibaba priced 710 million new HK-listed shares at HK$112.70 each (HK$80B total, ~US$10.2B) to invest in full-stack AI capabilities; Hong Kong's largest-ever follow-on offering closes today.
topStories.marketImpact: 9988.HK ↓~10%; Hang Seng ↓1.84% Monday; dilution and rising AI capex concerns weigh on Chinese tech broadly

topStories.headline: US Consumer Confidence Falls in August as Inflation Keeps Biting
topStories.summary: Conference Board CCI fell to 89.4 in August (vs 90.3 expected, 90.2 prior) and UMich Sentiment declined to 51 from 55.2 in July, as elevated prices and tariff concerns weigh on households.
topStories.marketImpact: Consumer discretionary ↓; XRT, AMZN, HD at risk; reinforces risk-off tone; may restrain Fed appetite for a September rate hike

topStories.headline: US 30-Year Treasury Yield Hits 19-Year High on Fiscal Deficit Concerns
topStories.summary: The 30-year Treasury yield touched 5.33% before settling at ~5.29%, while the 10-year holds around 4.70%, driven by persistent fiscal deficit worries, heavy debt issuance, and above-target inflation.
topStories.marketImpact: TLT ↓; mortgage and credit markets tightening; banks, REITs under pressure; gold ↑ on debasement trade; higher discount rates weigh on equities

topStories.headline: Bank of Japan Holds at 1% but Governor Ueda Warns Inflation May Exceed 2% Target
topStories.summary: BOJ kept rates at 1.0% at its July meeting but warned core inflation could exceed the 2% target from September; USD/JPY sits at ~159 after Tokyo intervened near 163.
topStories.marketImpact: JPY ↑ risk ahead of next BOJ decision; 7203.T, 6758.T earnings exposed to yen swings; Japanese financials watch ↑ on rate-hike expectations

topStories.headline: Sony Raises FY2026 Guidance After 40% Jump in Operating Income
topStories.summary: Sony Group reported a 40% surge in operating income for its latest quarter and upgraded its full-year profit forecasts; the stock has rallied ~10.9% over the past week.
topStories.marketImpact: SONY / 6758.T ↑; signals resilience in Japan's consumer electronics and entertainment segments despite macro headwinds

topStories.headline: Chinese Tech Sell-Off Deepens; CSI 300 at Three-Week Lows
topStories.summary: Shanghai Composite slipped 0.6% to 3,882 and CSI 300 fell 1.21% to 4,563, with ChiNext down 3.2% and STAR50 down 3.1%, as Alibaba's dilutive share placement rattled tech investor sentiment.
topStories.marketImpact: 0700.HK (Tencent), 9988.HK ↓; KWEB, CQQQ under pressure; broader Asia tech sentiment drag

topStories.headline: Gold Holds Near $4,650 — 3-Month High — on US Debt Debasement Trade
topStories.summary: Gold sustained gains near $4,650/oz after a 5%+ rally last week driven by the US Treasury's long-bond buyback program and the resulting dollar weakness.
topStories.marketImpact: GLD ↑; silver and gold miners tracking; USD-sensitive assets under pressure; bullion remains key hedge amid fiscal uncertainty
